fences.invocation_warning: NEVER quote a fence count without its invocation and its platform ref. The guards have five different invocation contracts and three fail CLOSED with rc=2 on a missing platform reference — excellent design, and indistinguishable from RED to any caller grading rc==0. A naive sweep reads 5 green / 10 red on a healthy corpus. This close proved it again on itself: two of its first three 'reds' were the runner using the wrong contract.
fences.red_proof_note: Every new fence was run against a FAITHFUL pre-fix mutant. A first, partial mutant left two reader fences GREEN — because the try/except (one of three layers) still caught it — so the mutant was rebuilt as the true pre-fix code before the RED was accepted. A fence proven by an insufficient mutant is not proven.
